powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass Import-Module .\function.ps1

# enumeration.ps1

function LDAPSearch {

    param ([string]$LDAPQuery)

    try {

        $PDC = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain().PdcRoleOwner.Name

        $DN = ([adsi]'').distinguishedName

        $Entry = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$PDC/$DN")

        $Searcher = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher($Entry, $LDAPQuery)

        return $Searcher.FindAll()

    } catch {

        Write-Error "AD 연결 실패: $_"

    }

}

# 실행부: 모든 유저의 SamAccountName과 Description 출력

$results = LDAPSearch -LDAPQuery "(samAccountType=805306368)"

foreach ($res in $results) {

    [PSCustomObject]@{

        Name = $res.Properties.samaccountname

        Description = $res.Properties.description

        Path = $res.Path

    }

}

 powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\enumeration2.ps1

![](data:image/png;base64,)

function LDAPSearch {  
    param (  
        [string]$LDAPQuery  
    )

$PDC = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain().PdcRoleOwner.Name  
    $DistinguishedName = ([adsi]'').distinguishedName

$DirectoryEntry = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$PDC/$DistinguishedName")

$DirectorySearcher = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectorySearcher($DirectoryEntry, $LDAPQuery)

return $DirectorySearcher.FindAll()

}
